sentences.text: Prevotella melaninogenica is a Gram-negative anaerobic commensal bacterium of the human oral cavity.
It is recovered from several oral sites in young children, with isolates reported from children of about four and thirty-two months, and from maternal saliva.
Ribotyping of 248 isolates found extensive genetic heterogeneity, with 101 distinct ribotypes.
The species carries orthologues of the type IX secretion system, and loss of its porK gene reduced haemagglutination and biofilm formation.
It has been reported as a pathogen of suppurative disease inside and outside the mouth, and studies group it with periodontopathic Prevotella species in children's supragingival plaque.
